_comment: Provider template — Claude (Anthropic official endpoint). In the DSH port the ORCHESTRATOR is DeepSeek, so Claude is heterogeneous by construction: no BASE_URL override, the claude CLI's own credentials route the call. No `_credential_env`: native auth — the wrapper skips token injection and the CLI uses its own credentials. ROUTING ONLY (no secret). See model-routing.md. ADR #40. EXTERNAL-HARNESS OPT-IN: substrate claude-code spawns the Claude Code CLI — a FOREIGN harness dragged into a DSH run. It is retained only for backends that expose no DSH adapter; the DSH-native default is no placeholder default (substrate dsh).
